title: Ordered results from unordered work
prompt:
1. `static List<Integer> fanout(List<Integer> inputs, Executor executor)` — for each
input, `supplyAsync(() -> input * 2, executor)`; after ALL complete (allOf + join),
return the results IN SUBMISSION ORDER (join each future in list order).
2. `static List<Integer> withFailures(List<Integer> inputs, Executor executor)` — same,
but odd inputs THROW; recover per-branch with handle → -1 for failed branches;
submission order preserved throughout.
Use `var f = CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(...)` per input; never trust join order
to equal completion order.

tests.name: submission order, per-branch recovery
tests.hint: Results ordered by submission, not by chance.
